verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs describe a single unified API endpoint accessing hundreds of models across 80+ providers, with a normalized schema/tool-calling interface, OpenAI-SDK drop-in compatibility, and consistent routing/fallback behavior, corroborated by independent developer testimonials praising the 'same API key and same request' experience across models and easy provider switching. missing for 10: no evidence of edge-case parity gaps (e.g., some sampling params not exposed) being resolved, and only community anecdotes (not rigorous benchmarks) validate consistency across providers.
